name: rhongomiant-spellshroud-non-targeting-spell-still-destroys-it
notes: Rhongomiant, Grove's Spire (clS3E0HrZL, EXALTED/NORM WARRIOR REGALIA/WEAPON): "Spellshroud (Objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.)" -- the first, unconditional keyword; only its two [Mordred Bonus] clauses are conditional. Spellshroud only stops targeting. Player 2 (champion patched with a TERA lineage so the TERA card is playable) plays Heartsong Reclamation ("Destroy all regalia you don't control", no target) for real (8 reserve payments): Rhongomiant is destroyed (ends in player 1's banishment) despite Spellshroud.

rulesClauses: Spellshroud only prevents being targeted by spells; effects that do not target still affect the object.
